definition.name: Compile exact standard WASI backend and bounded resource controls

steps.name: Check source ownership, original whole WIT and private bridge guards
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 -B -m unittest tools.tests.test_rust_wasi_http_profile tools.tests.test_rust_wasi_http_inputs_prepared -v

steps.name: Execute only the actual bounded options and fields implementation controls
Execute content-length finish and ownership controls
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
python3 -B tools/rust_wasi_http_finish_control.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-http-finish-method.rs" | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-http-finish-source.txt"
LSF_RUST_HTTP_FINISH_BODY="$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-http-finish-method.rs" rustc --edition=2021 --cfg lsf_exported_finish_control --test tools/fixtures/wasi-http-request-options/exchange-control.rs -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-http-exchange-controls"
"$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-http-exchange-controls" --test-threads=1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-http-exchange-controls.txt"

steps.name: Execute callback-safe readiness, cancellation and bounded waiter controls
Verify completed EOF retirement and pending cancellation ownership
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
rustc --edition=2021 -D warnings --test sdk/wasi-http-runtime/retirement.rs -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-http-retirement-controls"
"$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-http-retirement-controls" --test-threads=1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-http-retirement-controls.txt"

steps.name: Acquire only locked SDK compiler sources before offline compilation
Compile and authenticate only the selected WASI backend
Execute the actual compiled guest with independently held imports
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
cargo build --locked --offline -p latent-toolchain-smoke --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --example rust-http-pump-probe --features rust-wasi-http-cooperative --release
wasm-tools component new target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/examples/rust_http_pump_probe.wasm -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-http-pump-probe.wasm"
wasm-tools validate --features all "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-http-pump-probe.wasm"
cargo --config .cargo/managed-guest.toml --config profile.dev.opt-level=1 run --locked --offline -p latent-toolchain-smoke --example rust-http-pump-control -- "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-http-pump-probe.wasm" 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-http-pump-guest.txt"
cargo --config .cargo/managed-guest.toml --config profile.dev.opt-level=1 run --locked --offline -p latent-toolchain-smoke --example rust-http-pump-control -- "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-http-pump-probe.wasm" --native-profile 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-http-pump-native-guest.txt"

steps.name: Retain bounded compiler observations without build cache or signer credentials

with.name: rust-wasi-http-backend-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-resource-controls.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-exchange-controls.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-finish-source.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-finish-method.rs
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-runtime/INSTALL-COMPLETE.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-runtime/INSTALL-FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-runtime/source-inputs.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-runtime/reference.wit.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-runtime/adapter.wit.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-runtime/raw-runtime.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-runtime/rust-wasi-http-runtime.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-runtime/component-composer/wac
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-runtime/logs/*.stdout.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-runtime/logs/*.stderr.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-pump-controls.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-retirement-controls.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-pump-native-guest.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-pump-guest.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-pump-probe.wasm

reviewReason: Run the original backend compilation and controls, adding the bounded Content-Length finish and owner-retention control without changing deadlines or authority.
